Package index

Model layer

Fit a posterior survival object (psurv) from any backend

fit_bayes_survival()
Fit a Bayesian survival model and return a psurv.
psurv_external()
External-validation psurv: evaluate a coxph's Laplace posterior on NEW data.
psurv_from_coxph()
Fallback constructor: posterior draws from a frequentist Cox fit.
psurv_from_pwexp()
Piecewise-exponential (Poisson-trick) Bayesian PH model -> psurv.
psurv_from_bart()
BART survival (nonparametric Bayesian) model -> psurv.
psurv_from_stan_surv()
Build a psurv from an rstanarm::stan_surv fit (the primary Bayesian PH model).
fit_stan_pwexp()
Fit a full-Bayes piecewise-exponential PH model and return a rich object.
stan_pwexp_predict()
External-validation psurv from a fitted stan_pwexp model on new data.
new_psurv()
Construct a posterior survival object.
make_psurv_fitter()
Build a fit_psurv closure for bb_optimism(): function(data, weights) -> psurv.

MCMC diagnostics and priors

check_mcmc_gate() mcmc_gate()
Convergence gate: TRUE only if Rhat < max_rhat, ESS >= min_ess, no divergences.
mcmc_diagnostics()
MCMC convergence diagnostics for a fitted Bayesian survival model.
prior_sensitivity()
Prior-sensitivity analysis (checklist 1): refit the primary Bayesian PH model (fit_stan_pwexp) under several log-HR prior SDs and compare the posterior of each performance estimator. A robust conclusion should be stable across weakly-informative priors; a large shift flags prior-dependence.
loo_survival()
PSIS-LOO elpd from a pointwise log-likelihood matrix [S x n].

Caching

Fit a psurv with transparent disk caching.
psurv_cache_key()
Deterministic cache key for a psurv fit from its defining inputs.
save_psurv()
Save a psurv to disk (creates the directory).
load_psurv()
Load a psurv from disk (validates the class).
clear_psurv_cache()
Remove cached psurv files.

Uncertainty propagation

The one idea — propagate any frequentist estimator across the posterior

propagate_metric()
Propagate a per-draw metric across the posterior (B2), optionally with the Bayesian bootstrap (B3).
propagate_many()
Convenience: propagate several named metric functions in one pass over the draws (cheaper than one pass each — the survival object is only sliced once).
propagate_bootstrap()
Propagate a metric with the Bayesian bootstrap (B2 + B3 in one call). Thin alias for propagate_metric(..., weights = "bootstrap").
posterior_table()
Format a posterior_metric (or several) as a median [95% CrI] table.
posterior_vs_frequentist()
Side-by-side Bayesian vs frequentist headline table (Part D).
variance_decomposition()
Decompose posterior variance into parameter vs evaluation-sample sources.
bb_weights()
Generate a matrix of Bayesian-bootstrap weights [S x n] (rows sum to 1).
bb_replicates()
Bayesian-bootstrap replicates of a metric on a SINGLE fixed prediction set.
bb_optimism()
Bayesian-bootstrap optimism correction for a scalar performance estimator.

Discrimination metrics

metric_harrell_c()
Harrell's C (per draw). Wraps survival::concordance with case weights.
metric_uno_c()
Uno's C (IPCW, truncated at tau) per draw. survival::concordance with timewt = "n/G2" is the Uno estimator; ymax = tau truncates.
metric_gonen_k()
Gonen-Heller K (per draw) — model-based concordance from eta only, so it is independent of the study censoring distribution. Closed form (A1): K = sum_{i!=j} w_i w_j I(eta_i > eta_j) / (1 + exp(eta_j - eta_i)) normalised by the pair weight mass. O(n^2); intended for moderate n.
metric_antolini_c()
Antolini's time-dependent concordance (per draw) — A1.4. Uses the model's time-specific survival: a usable pair (i event at Ytilde_i, j later) is concordant when S_i(Ytilde_i) < S_j(Ytilde_i), i.e. the subject who failed had the lower predicted survival AT THAT TIME. For a PH model this reduces to Harrell's C; for flexible / non-PH models whose curves may cross it is the natural single summary. Survival at the (arbitrary) event times is obtained by interpolating each subject's cumulative hazard across the horizon knots.
metric_td_auc()
Time-dependent (cumulative/dynamic) AUC at each horizon, IPCW, per draw. Cases: T_i <= t & event; controls: T_j > t. Uses the predicted risk 1 - S_i(t) as the marker and IPCW weights G-hat from the censoring KM.

Calibration metrics

metric_citl()
Calibration-in-the-large at each horizon (per draw): mean predicted risk vs observed (weighted Kaplan-Meier) risk.
metric_cal_slope()
Calibration slope (per draw): coefficient of a Cox model with eta as the sole covariate. slope < 1 signals overfitting (van Houwelingen shrinkage).
metric_ici()
ICI / E50 / E90 at a horizon (per draw): mean / 50th / 90th percentile of |pi_i(t) - pi_hat^cal_i(t)| (Austin, Harrell & van Klaveren 2020).
metric_dcalibration()
D-calibration (per draw) — A2.6, Haider et al. (JMLR 2020). Distributional calibration of the WHOLE predicted survival distribution, not one horizon: if the model is calibrated, u_i = S_i(T_i) is Uniform(0,1). Bin [0,1] into bins equal cells; an event contributes 1 to its cell, a censored subject (known only that its true u < S_i(c_i)) spreads its unit mass uniformly over [0, S_i(c_i)] across cells. The Pearson statistic vs the expected count n/bins tests uniformity (chi-square, bins-1 df).
ppc_calibration()
Posterior predictive calibration check at a horizon.
plot_calibration_band()
Plot a posterior calibration band from ppc_calibration() (ggplot2).

Overall performance

metric_brier()
IPCW Brier score at each horizon (per draw). BS(t) = sum_i w_i * Ŵ_i(t) * (I(Ytilde_i > t) - S_i(t))^2 Ŵ_i(t): 1/G(T_i-) for events before t, 1/G(t) for survivors past t, 0 for subjects censored before t.
metric_ipa()
Index of Prediction Accuracy (scaled Brier) at each horizon (per draw): IPA(t) = 1 - BS_model(t) / BS_null(t), null = marginal Kaplan-Meier.
metric_r2d()
Royston-Sauerbrei R^2_D (per draw) — explained variation from the ordered linear predictor. D is the Cox coefficient on scaled normal rankit scores. R^2_D = (D^2/kappa^2) / (pi^2/6 + D^2/kappa^2), kappa = sqrt(8/pi).

Decision curve

net_benefit_draw()
Net benefit across thresholds for a single draw.
posterior_net_benefit()
Posterior net-benefit curves over draws (B6).
plot_net_benefit()
Plot posterior net-benefit bands from posterior_net_benefit() (ggplot2).

Configuration

bc_config()
Get the framework configuration, with optional per-call overrides.
bc_horizons()
Resolve evaluation horizons from data (or return the configured horizons).
bc_tau()
Resolve the truncation tau (largest horizon when cfg$tau is NULL).

Plot helpers

bc_palette
Okabe-Ito colourblind-safe palette. Pick series colours by name; never introduce ad-hoc colours. Reference/guide lines are grey (see below).
theme_bayesval()
The house theme: theme_classic() with a top legend and bold facet strips.
number_ticks()
pretty()-based axis ticks. Use as scale_*_continuous(breaks = number_ticks(6)).
bc_ggsave()
Write a figure at house resolution through a device that emits plain sRGB.
